_what: Where each manifest under backend/test/fixtures (used by the BIDS index tests, epic #1586 Phase 2, #1588) came from. backend/test/bids-index-session-modalities.test.ts recomputes every fixture_sha256 and fails on a mismatch.

bids-index-sessions/manifest-on004196-v1.derivation: The served manifest.json is an array of {path, size, checksum_algorithm, checksum, bytes_url, url}. Each entry became files[path] = {key, size, checksum}: for algorithm git, key = checksum = 'git:<sha>'; otherwise checksum = '<algorithm>:<sha>' and key is the annex key, the last path segment of url after /objects/ (asserted to start with '<BACKEND>-s<size>--<sha>'). bytes_url and url were dropped. dataset_id and version are the dataset's; doi and concept_doi are null; created is the version row's created_at (extensions.nemar.versions / provenance.publish_date of the same dataset's metadata.json, UTC) as ISO 8601. Paths are in served order, which is ascending.
